name: Paso Robles Highlands District

known.via: English Wikipedia "Paso Robles Highlands District AVA"

terms: American Viticultural Area. A wine labeled with one must take at least 85% of its grapes from that area.

notes: With hot days and cool sea-air evenings, Paso Robles makes Zinfandel known for being soft and round.

blurb.text: A district of canyons and highlands inside the Paso Robles AVA, east of Creston. At ⟦area|60,300 acres|24,400 hectares⟧ it is the second-largest in Paso Robles, reaching from near Shandon to the base of the La Panza Range.
